_comment: CV610 craft (.181): RTL8733BU on devourer at 5745/HT20, originator 18 / net_id 1 — distinct from the .232 craft (17/0) for dual-craft testing. §10.5 TX power is BENCH-LOW: power_offset_qdb -96 is this unit's measured floor, 24 dB below the EFUSE table, chosen for 50 cm bench geometry — RAISE IT before any range or flight test (see deploy/README.md). venc §9.6 bitrate actuation ON (live-verified 2026-08-15): max_bitrate_kbps 12288 (operator, 2026-08-16 — the 8000 first pinned here was too strict). The 8000 figure came from the 720p100 profile bring-up (venc video0.size 1280x720; ~1030 pps, air loss 0.3%, CPU ~60% of one core vs ~99% at 1080p/12000), which measured a CPU wall, not a link wall. 12288 sits just above the 12000 that measured zero drops at 1080p in-process and below the 13000 that dropped 0.3-2.3 fps — re-measure if frames start slipping. Ceiling context: 8733BU rung-5 drain is ~14.4 Mbps standalone; IN-PROCESS (waybeam-hub mod_wblink tx) hub residency costs ~1 Mbps of TX-pump margin (13000 clean standalone dropped 0.3-2.3 fps in-process; 12000 measured zero at 1080p) — the table-8733b derived target (19.6 Mbps) overshoots because its airtime/FEC constants are 8812-calibrated seeds (§17 re-derive pending). frame_caps false: CV610 venc returns 501 on video0.maxIBytes/maxPBytes and the failed caps txn's holdoff starves the bitrate push. §7.5 uplink streams mirror the .232 craft.

adapters._comment: §10.5 offset space. The 8733BU gained its TX-power actuator in devourer #399 (vendored at 5bf059a) — before that GetTxPowerCaps().supported was false and every write landed on IRtlDevice's do-nothing default, so this adapter deliberately carried no power keys. Floor MEASURED at the ground 2026-08-16, not assumed: 0/-16/-32/-48/-64/-80/-96 qdb read -32/-38/-40/-42/-46/-54/-56 dBm — 96 qdb commanded, 24 dB delivered, dead-on the 0.25 dB/qdB nominal, video held ~100 fps at every step and the craft's own RX of the uplink never moved. -112 and -128 add nothing and past -128 the actuator reports saturated_low true (the int8 delta field's rail). power_offset_max_qdb 16 is the measured edge of USABLE overdrive on this part: +16 qdb buys +2.8 dB while EVM already goes -62 -> -50, and +32 collapses it to -18 with SNR never noticing.

air._comment_usb_tx_agg: USB TX aggregation: frames per bulk-OUT URB. Host CPU only — same frames, same airtime, and it defers nothing, because it batches only frames the framer already emitted back to back. Measured on THIS craft 2026-08-17 at ~1100 pps: 337->260 and 316->223 us/frame, 8.6-10.5 points of one core, pps unchanged (1104->1101, 1107->1100). Mechanism confirmed at the kernel on the same 8733BU part: 10974 -> 4347 bulk-OUT URBs for identical frames, frames/URB 1.00 -> 2.52 — not 3.00, because partial runs flush at fan-out boundaries and control frames stay unbatched.

venc._modes_comment: §15.5/§16 operating-mode store. mode_apply_cmd being non-empty is what flips apply_configured true and makes §11.7 0x07 MODE answerable. The nine imx662-*.json from profiles/modes/ install into modes_dir; apply-mode.conf next to them sets VENC_RESTART=api, WITHOUT WHICH an apply would run S95waybeam restart and unload the CV610 MPP stack. Catalog fingerprint 9-54cfcc7e — the ground pins the same nine under originator 18.
